detailedExplanation: This note supports 35 source-backed questions on Nouns and dictionary entries.

Learn each Latin entry together with its complete meaning and any supplied grammar clue. Recognition is only the first step: cover the answer, retrieve it independently, then use the word in a translated or analysed sentence.
examTips: Mark the finite verb first, then use noun endings to assign subject, object and recipient roles.
Normal Latin word order can vary; the case, number, gender, person and tense endings cannot.
For English to Latin, build each required form before arranging the sentence.
